_note: A deposit's gain is outside the capital-gains head: what portfolio records on a fixed deposit is its interest, income from other sources, entered there (OS-INTEREST), so a bucket this row reaches is left out of the head with a nil line naming it, never computed twice (W-160a, D-363; C2a). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.92(1) (p.137), the residual charge OS-INTEREST's note quotes. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.56(1) (thc p.303). Reached by capitalgains.asset = FD. Conditions only; introduction and provenance are OS-INTEREST's. Every regime.
